title: Commenter Network Expansion
scenario: Find users who have commented on at least 10 different categories.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, category_id INT), comments (comment_id INT, article_id INT, user_id INT)
correctQuery: SELECT user_id FROM comments c JOIN articles a USING (article_id) GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.category_id) >= 10;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, category_id INT); CREATE TABLE comments (comment_id INT, article_id INT, user_id INT);
